findings.title: Annotation-leading lexical decoys can become Confirmed/High facts
findings.evidence: The detector accepts any line beginning with @ or [ and then searches the complete line for a supported token. @SuppressWarnings("@DubboService") and [Description("[ApiController]")] therefore match despite containing the supported token only inside another annotation's string argument.
findings.required_remediation: Add annotation-leading decoy regression REDs and recognize only exact supported annotation or attribute invocations.

findings.title: Committed configuration-only artifacts are never inspected
findings.evidence: Detection iterates only RepositoryProfileDraft.CodeUnits and applies configuration matching only to those source ranges. The accepted contract separately requires committed package-manifest/configuration candidates through the safe snapshot boundary; the existing test embeds a configuration key inside a Java Code Unit and does not prove a configuration-only artifact.
findings.required_remediation: Add configuration-only regression REDs and safely enumerate bounded committed configuration candidates without dirty-root, network, package, or source-retention behavior.

findings.title: Case-insensitive duplicate-path detection rejects valid case-distinct Linux trees
findings.evidence: Snapshot archive duplicate detection uses StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase unconditionally.
findings.required_remediation: Add an OS-appropriate comparer regression test or record this as a truthful nonblocking limitation if unchanged.
